svg.data-optics-qsfp112: datasheet: each 400G QSFP112 port takes 1 x 400 GbE or breaks out to "2 x 200GbE, and 4 x 100GbE via breakout cables". The qualified list is named in full: 400G DAC, 400G AOC, 400G QSFP112 SR4, 200G QSFP56-SR4, and at 100G DAC, AOC, SR4, LR4, DR1, FR1 and LR1. More are referred to the vendor's site.
